description: the 715-protein core list re-run with the walker run's API versions (control for database drift)
uses_values: list membership and UP/DOWN direction only; node log2FC is blank on value_source=assigned rows and no p-value is attached to any node
caveat: n=2 technical replicates per condition (no biological replication); 0/1938 proteins survive FDR<0.05 (limma). The 715 seed proteins are the |log2FC|>=0.585 HYPOTHESIS-GENERATING set. Same-version CONTROL run of the committed 715 list; exploratory.
